description: Horizon 2 live-adapter device model: v1 objects plus Trend Log for ReadRange. Notification Class is optional peer-side scaffolding for EventNotification tests.

objects.description: Interop AV-1 baseline present-value used for ReadProperty, WriteProperty, COV, WPM, and segmented RPM stress.
Pre-seeded log-buffer for ReadRange byPosition interop (bacnet-stack / BACnet4J).

notes: Supersedes device-baseline-v1 for new adapter images; v1 remains frozen for historical digests.
bacnet-stack: TrendLog via MAX_TREND_LOGS=1 + handler_read_range; ReinitializeDevice / DCC with empty password; no EventNotification emit.
BACpypes3: same AV/BV; no server ReadRange (NotImplementedError); WPM adapter-shim; ReinitializeDevice SimpleACK; BACNET_EMIT_EVENT=1 UnconfirmedEventNotification.
BACnet4J: TrendLogObject with seeded buffer; ReinitializeDevice no-op warmstart handler; BACNET_EMIT_EVENT=1 UnconfirmedEventNotification.
